answer: At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a thread tag. The vault cap is enforced at intake and walnut shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a swarm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 16 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
